parameters.content:
## ① Collect & Screen (stage 1 of a run, called by A)
**Which sources**: this run's new sources, plus up to 200 earlier sources of the domain whose download failed or gave no real text (each is downloaded at most twice).
**Collect Materials** downloads what a reader needs into the source library (codex-runner `/collect`): for papers the open full text from Europe PMC or an open-access PDF; bot-check and redirect pages are discarded; when no full text can be had, the abstract is kept.
**C1 · Screen** (GPT-6 Luna) checks every downloaded source against the definition of AI4SG and the domain: passed sources wait in the queue for stage ②, the others are set aside with the reason. A source that belongs to another domain as well (or instead) is tagged with it and waits in that domain's queue too. Sources whose screen failed are screened again here.

parameters.query:
-- downloaded earlier but never screened, or the screen's answer did not fit the format: screened again now
SELECT id AS source_id FROM sources
WHERE status = 'collected' AND domain IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($2, '') AND NOT (id = ANY($1::bigint[]))
ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

-- this run's new sources, plus up to 200 earlier ones in this domain whose download failed, or that the first collector
-- (before text_level existed) saved with no real text (a bot check, a redirect page, a stub): at most 2 tries each
SELECT id AS source_id, url, doi, files, false AS retry FROM sources WHERE id = ANY($1::bigint[])
UNION ALL
(SELECT s.id, s.url, s.doi, '[]'::jsonb, true FROM sources s
 WHERE s.domain IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($2, '') AND NOT (s.id = ANY($1::bigint[])) AND COALESCE(s.collect_tries, 0) < 2
   AND (s.status = 'collect_failed'
        OR (s.status IN ('passed', 'collected') AND s.text_level IS NULL AND COALESCE(s.text_chars, 0) < 3000)
        OR (s.status = 'extracted' AND s.text_level IS NULL AND COALESCE(s.text_chars, 0) < 3000 AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM extractions e WHERE e.source_id = s.id AND e.status = 'filtered_out'
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.extraction_id = e.id))))
 ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 200)

-- a retried source that now has real text goes back to the screen; an extraction that was judged on a bot-check page
-- (and not reviewed yet) is dropped so the source is analysed again. A failed retry leaves the source as it was.
WITH old AS (SELECT id, status FROM sources WHERE id = $1),
dropped AS (
  DELETE FROM extractions e USING old
  WHERE $4::boolean AND $6::boolean AND e.source_id = old.id AND old.status = 'extracted' AND e.status = 'filtered_out'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.extraction_id = e.id)
  RETURNING e.id)
UPDATE sources s SET
  collect_tries = COALESCE(s.collect_tries, 0) + 1, collected_at = now(),
  files      = CASE WHEN $4::boolean OR NOT $6::boolean THEN $2::jsonb ELSE s.files END,
  text_chars = CASE WHEN $4::boolean OR NOT $6::boolean THEN $3::int ELSE s.text_chars END,
  text_level = CASE WHEN $4::boolean OR NOT $6::boolean THEN NULLIF($5, '') ELSE s.text_level END,
  status = CASE WHEN $4::boolean AND (old.status <> 'extracted' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM dropped) > 0
                                      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM extractions e WHERE e.source_id = s.id)) THEN 'collected'
                WHEN NOT $6::boolean AND NOT $4::boolean THEN 'collect_failed'
                ELSE s.status END
FROM old WHERE s.id = old.id
RETURNING s.id AS source_id, s.status, s.text_chars
